in_sanskrit.name: लोहर

in_tamil.name: லோஹார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who lives in a village where iron is smelted, Iron smith, Blacksmith

in_marathi.name: Lohar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lohar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Lohar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lohit' which means 'Red' or 'Blacksmith'. It is an occupational name for those who were once involved in the traditional craft of making and mending iron and steel tools.

in_bengali.name: Lohar

It is an occupational name for those who were once involved in the traditional craft of making and mending iron and steel tools.
